## Episode Thesis

The episode is a Dagens Industri discussion the morning after the 2026 Swedish election. The red-green side appears to have won by three seats, but government formation is expected to be long and messy because of the Centre Party's and Left Party's red lines. The guests focus on household-finance risks from possible negotiation trade-offs, such as a property tax, a bank or 'mortgage' tax, ISK caps and higher marginal taxes. They also note that Stockholm stock futures pointed 0.6% lower before the open. No individual equities were discussed with a directional view.
